title: LateFeesAssessed
description: Emitted when a past-due account is charged a late fee. Replaces PaymentService.assessLateFee(), previously called synchronously from LoanService.runEndOfDayProcessing().

eventId.description: Unique identifier for this event instance.

occurredAt.description: When the late fee was assessed (ISO 8601, UTC).

version.description: Schema version of the event contract.

loanId.description: Identifier of the loan being assessed a late fee.

daysPastDue.description: Number of days the account is past due.

assessmentDate.description: When the late fee was assessed (ISO 8601, UTC).
